description: Feature-validate proceeds against the working tree when dev-{N}.json is missing but git ground truth finds real work.
failure_mode: Model reports 'no implementation work' or exits even though feature-dev left real changes on disk.
prompt: Phase 0 of feature-validate finds .nightgauge/pipeline/dev-134.json missing. You run `nightgauge gate verify feature-dev 134 --workdir . --json` and it reports terminal_kind: "dev_handoff_missing" with 2 files (internal/scan/testcmd.go, cmd/nightgauge/main.go) and exit code 2. What do you do? End your answer with a single ```json fenced block containing exactly this object, with one value chosen for each field: {"action": "proceed_against_working_tree" | "report_no_work" | "exit", "files_to_validate": [<paths>]}

assertions.description: validates the files git ground truth found
